ago. Well, I think I got overruled, wrongly, in a local tournament last

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
ffOn 24 Nov 1999, Mikko Saari wrote:
> Reverend Blackwood does 1 additional damage with each Thaumaturgy strike.
> What about Theft of Vitae? Am I right if I say that Theft of Vitae does no
> damage at all, so there cannot be any additional damage. So, only normal

Correct. There is no source of damage to add to, so only normal theft
will occur.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Mikko Saari wrote:
>
> If I remember correct, there was some discussion about this guy some time
> ago. Well, I think I got overruled, wrongly, in a local tournament last
> week so I would like to receive a confirmation for this:
>

> Reverend Blackwood does 1 additional damage with each Thaumaturgy strike.
> What about Theft of Vitae? Am I right if I say that Theft of Vitae does no
> damage at all, so there cannot be any additional damage. So, only normal
> blood loss from Theft of Vitae will occur.

Correct.

Damage (Combat)

* Adding damage to strikes which are not damage dealing strikes will not
deal damage (e.g., using Lucky Blow and choosing your Rowan Ring melee
weapon won't deal damage) [RTR 19960221]
